cds.title: Pepperdine University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF linked from the Office of Institutional Effectiveness CDS page)

stats.notes: Test-optional: only 17% of enrolled first-years submitted SAT and 8% ACT, so the score ranges describe a self-selected group. CDS C21 (Fall 2025 class) reports ED applicant/admit counts as 'na' because ED starts with the fall 2026 applicant pool. Residency (in-state/international) applicant counts and class rank (C10) were not reported. Fall 2025 applicant counts cover Seaver College first-years only.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A/C8F (Fall 2025): SAT/ACT not required for admission but considered if submitted; same consideration with or without scores. Scores are required to be considered for the Regents Scholars Program scholarships.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5/H6 (2026-2027 costs). Food and housing figure is the first-year on-campus amount (undergraduates overall: $23,260). G5 also lists $1,000 transportation. H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; the 145 recipients averaged $36,013 (non-need-based awards).
